main_text.head: PRAEFATIO.
main_text.p: meis uigilijs significanda esse duxi: quae quanti mihi constiterint, plurimi optimi & doctissimi uiri norunt. Tu uero, eo animo, quo tibi trado, suscipe: ac Vale.

page.notes: The right edge strip shows the adjacent page's margin notes, cut off by the scan and largely illegible; left out as neighbouring-page material. No page number, running head or catchword is printed on this page. The "A D" line is set in bold, with a larger A.
